title: iberis intermedia var. maialis
intro: Iberis intermedia var. maialis, commonly known as Candytuft, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Candytuft include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and act as a natural antiseptic. The bioactive constituents present in Candytuft include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
